summary:
Updated Implementation Plan for NutriPulse AI (v5.1 Multi-Tier Resilient Edition). 
Addresses user's critical App Check token feedback by implementing a 3-Tier Fail-Safe AI Engine:
1. Tier 1: Firebase AI Logic with Debug App Check token persistence
2. Tier 2: Direct Gemini API fallback using BuildConfig.GEMINI_API_KEY (uncommented in .env.example) to prevent App Check VPN/attestation blocking
3. Tier 3: Instant offline manual meal logging fallback modal
Also includes Room offline storage, regional Indian prompt injection, background nudges, Compose Canvas analytics graphs, and branded PDF clinical report export (Ayush Kumar).
